title: Webel
summary: A live home-services marketplace. I am responsible for its B2C and B2B web surfaces, internal dashboard, SEO, email, and shared component library.
problem: Webel connects people who need a service with professionals who provide it. The web platform has to present that supply, support operations, and stay coherent across products with different needs.
audience: People who need a service, professionals offering their work, and companies managing services for their teams.
role: Responsible for the web platform. I work across architecture and implementation, then review outcomes with Product and the wider engineering team.
responsibilities: Webel Organizations, the B2B platform: employees, services, calendar, leads, chat, tax details, service areas, schedules and payouts.
Marketplace core: search and browsing the offer. Full migration from Angular to React; today it's a storefront that redirects to the apps, with no login or users.
SEO surface in Astro, with structured data and an architecture suited to static content.
The internal dashboard the team runs operations with.
Architecture unification across Organizations, dashboard and marketplace, and extracting the design system into a shared component library.
Moved email development to React Email.
Created reusable skills and agent-ready design-system documentation for AI-assisted engineering.
decisions: Unify the stack on React across the big products, including the Angular to React marketplace migration, so the team works in one language.
Extract the design system into a shared component library across products.
Build programmatic SEO from scratch in Astro.
Encode recurring decisions in skills and documentation so delegated agent work starts with the technical context it needs.
outcomes: React across the main applications, React Email for email, and Astro for the SEO surface.
A shared library for reusing components and keeping the design system consistent across products.
An agent workflow based on specifications, reusable skills, code review, and final validation.
contribution: Ownership of the web surfaces, their migrations, and the shared architecture.
proof: Angular-to-React migration for the B2C application.
confidentialityNote: User, GMV, SEO-template, and email-volume figures remain private until validated.
